title: 第432章 你的计划第431章 隐岚密谋
slug: 天神传说第438章改革开始
content_zh:
“他会一直都在吗？”
易水华眯着眼睛，一脸奸笑的看着许风。
“你什么意思。”许风看着易水华。
“别忘了，哲的身份是什么，他是影的人，会在白夜谷待太长时间吗，依我看，长渊宗的那小子和哲的关系可不一般啊，哲这样做，无非是为了给那小子铺路，等到哲一走，长渊宗那几个老家伙，还是威胁吗，到时候我们联手，白夜谷便是唾手可得。”
易水华那极其充满诱惑力的话语，瞬间打动了许风的心，但许风很快冷静下来，也是不容易啊，竟然能看到许风冷静下来思考问题了。
“长渊宗还有那尊大家伙，就算是哲走了，我们的胜算也不会太大。”许风道。
“所以我们就要速战速决，那尊大家伙需要启动时间，我们只要第一时间把长渊宗那几个老东西全杀了，那个大家伙便不足为惧。”易水华道。
许风听完之后，还是有些不太自信。
“你还拉拢了谁。”许风问道。
“只有你，其余人我都信不过，释玉现在全听她师父的话，而那个什么祖师在大殿内你见她反驳了吗，一句模棱两可的三思而后行就打发走了所有人，至于云鹤，摇摆不定，不是忠心之人，雅曼，我看只怕是早就和哲串通一气了。”易水华道。
“那你这简直是胡闹，就凭我们两个宗门，去攻打对面四个宗门，何来的胜算，怎么可能第一时间将所有人全都杀死，这件事，要干你自己干，别拉着我去送死。”许风起身背对着易水华。
“哼。”易水华轻笑了一声，站起身。
“许阁主，我劝你还是好好想一想，是放弃宗门传承，在长渊宗脚底下当一条狗苟延残喘，被慢慢吞噬的好，还是和我一起，奋力一搏，争当白夜第一的好，我相信许阁主一定会有一个答案的。”易水华说完，笑着走出青岚阁大殿。
“阁主，我们……”殿外跑进来两名弟子。
“让他走。”许风背着身说道。
“是，阁主。”两名弟子退下。
“易水华。”许风转过身，目光看着前方，随后皱了皱眉，转身走出大殿。
长渊宗，后山。
哲带着苏少卿还有雅曼走入房间，随后用武气笼罩整个房间，隔音。
“哲叔，你是不是有点太冲动了，这确实不合适啊。”苏少卿举起手中的宗主令玉佩。（长渊佩）

“没什么不合适的，你现在还不懂，日后，你会需要这个身份的。”哲别有意味的看着苏少卿。
“苏少卿，接下来的三个月，我不会对你的武道方面进行训练，从今天开始，直到过完年，我会教导你如何管理一个宗门，如何在乱世立足，之后，我会对你进行为期一年的特训。”哲道。
苏少卿闻言，虽然依旧压力山大，但还是点了点头。
“三个月，你确定他能行。”一旁的雅曼看着哲问道。
“不行也得行，我们一起努力。”哲看向雅曼。
“啊？我？”雅曼有些懵。
“这里好像当过宗主的只有你吧，你刚才不是还有建议吗，怎么，忘了。”哲道。
“你们不是都商量的差不多了吗，就按照你们说的来呗。”雅曼道。
哲看向雅曼，一句话不说，雅曼被看的有些心虚。
“行了行了，我教还不行啊。”雅曼撇了撇嘴看向苏少卿。
“小朋友，我帮你可以，但是你要答应我一个条件哦。”雅曼笑道。
“啊？什么条件？”苏少卿问道。
“帮我追你哲叔叔。”雅曼笑道。
content_en:
"Will he always be here?"
Yi Shuihua squinted his eyes and looked at Xu Feng with a wicked smile.
"What do you mean?" Xu Feng looked at Yi Shuihua.
"Don't forget, what is Zhe's identity? He is a member of the shadow. Will he stay in Baiye Valley for too long? In my opinion, the relationship between the boy from Changyuan Sect and Zhe is not ordinary. Zhe did this just to pave the way for that boy. Once Zhe leaves, will those old guys from Changyuan Sect still be a threat? When we join forces, Baiye Valley will be at our fingertips."
Yi Shuihua's extremely tempting words instantly touched Xu Feng's heart, but Xu Feng calmed down quickly. It was not easy. He could actually see Xu Feng calm down and think about the problem.
"There is still that big guy from Changyuan Sect. Even if Zhe leaves, our chances of winning will not be great." Xu Feng said.
"So we have to fight quickly. The big guy needs time to activate. As long as we kill all the old guys from the Changyuan Sect as soon as possible, the big guy won't be afraid." Yi Shuihua said.
After hearing this, Xu Feng was still a little unsure.
"Who else did you win over?" Xu Feng asked.
"Only you, I can't trust anyone else. Shi Yu now only listens to her master's words, and did you see her refute that so-and-so Patriarch in the hall? She sent everyone away with an ambiguous thought before acting. As for Yun He, he is wavering and is not a loyal person. Yaman, I think I am afraid that he has colluded with Zhe a long time ago." Yi Shuihua said.
"Then what you are doing is nonsense. Just rely on our two sects to attack the four opposite sects. How can we win? How can we kill everyone at once? You have to do this yourself. Don't drag me to death." Xu Feng stood up and turned his back to Yi Shuihua.
"Humph." Yi Shuihua chuckled and stood up.
"Pavilion Master Xu, I advise you to think about it carefully. Is it better to give up the sect's inheritance and live as a dog under the feet of Changyuan Sect and be slowly devoured, or join me and fight hard to be the best in the white night? I believe Pavilion Master Xu will have an answer." After Yi Shuihua finished speaking, he walked out of the Qinglan Pavilion hall with a smile.
"Pavilion Master, we..." Two disciples ran in from outside the hall.
"Let him go." Xu Feng said with his back turned.
"Yes, Pavilion Master." The two disciples retreated.
"Yi Shuihua." Xu Feng turned around, looked ahead, then frowned, turned around and walked out of the hall.
Changyuan Sect, back mountain.
Zhe walked into the room with Su Shaoqing and Yaman, and then enveloped the entire room with martial energy to isolate the sound.
"Uncle Zhe, are you a little too impulsive? This is really inappropriate." Su Shaoqing raised the sect master's order jade pendant in his hand. (Zhang Yuanpei)
"There's nothing inappropriate. You don't understand now. In the future, you will need this identity." Zhebie looked at Su Shaoqing meaningfully.
"Su Shaoqing, for the next three months, I will not train you in martial arts. From today until the end of the New Year, I will teach you how to manage a sect and how to gain a foothold in troubled times. After that, I will give you a one-year special training." Zhedao.
When Su Shaoqing heard this, although he was still stressed, he still nodded.
"Three months, are you sure he can do it?" Yaman looked at Zhe and asked.
"It's okay even if it doesn't work. Let's work hard together." Zhe looked at Yaman.
"Huh? Me?" Yaman was a little confused.
"It seems that you are the only one who has ever been a sect master here. Didn't you have some suggestions just now? Why, you forgot them." Zhe said.
"Don't you guys have already agreed? Just do what you said." Yaman said.
Zhe looked at Yaman without saying a word. Yaman felt a little guilty.
"Okay, okay, I can't teach you enough." Yaman curled his lips and looked at Su Shaoqing.
"Kid, I can help you, but you have to agree to one condition." Yaman said with a smile.
"Ah? What are the conditions?"Su Shaoqing asked.
"Help me chase your Uncle Zhe." Yaman smiled.
